title: Log in with the new password after a password reset
preconditions: A Dormouse account whose password has just been changed using the emailed link. The app is installed and logged out.
steps: Open the Dormouse app.
Enter the account's email address and the new password.
Tap Log in.
Log out, then try to log in again with the old password.
expected: The new password opens the home screen with the account's thermostats. The old password is refused with 'Incorrect email or password'.

title: Log in with the new password after a password reset
preconditions: A Dormouse account whose password has just been changed using the emailed link. The app is installed and logged out.
steps: Open the Dormouse app.
Enter the account's email address and the new password.
Tap Log in.
Log out, then try to log in again with the old password.
expected: The new password opens the home screen with the account's thermostats. The old password is refused with 'Incorrect email or password'.

title: Account recovery regression: every way back into a locked account
preconditions: Three test accounts: one with a forgotten password, one locked after five wrong attempts, one with two-step verification switched on.
steps: Request a reset link for the first account, change its password and log in.
Request a second link and check the first one has stopped working.
Wait 30 minutes on the locked account, then log in with the right password.
Log in to the third account on a new phone and enter the emailed code.
Repeat each path with the phone in airplane mode and check the error messages.
expected: Every account can be recovered. Used and replaced links are refused, the lock lifts after 30 minutes, and every offline attempt shows a clear 'No connection' message.

title: Sign-in screen layout
preconditions: The app is installed and signed out.
steps: Open the app.
Check the sign-in screen shows the Dormouse logo, an email field, a password field, a Sign in button and a 'Reset your password' link.
Leave the password field empty and look at the Sign in button.
expected: Every element is visible without scrolling, and Sign in stays disabled until both fields are filled in.

title: Password reset email arrives within two minutes
preconditions: A Dormouse account with a mailbox the tester can read.
steps: Open the web dashboard and choose 'Forgot your password?'.
Enter the account's email address and submit.
Start a timer and watch the mailbox.
expected: An email from Dormouse with a reset link arrives within two minutes. The link opens a page to choose a new password.

title: Display shows E-217 when the temperature sensor is disconnected
preconditions: A test thermostat with its back cover off, so the temperature sensor cable can be unplugged.
steps: Unplug the temperature sensor cable.
Wait one minute and read the display.
Plug the cable back in and wait one minute.
expected: E-217 appears within one minute and heating switches off for safety. The error clears and normal control resumes once the sensor is reconnected.

title: E-104 appears when Wi-Fi pairing times out
preconditions: A thermostat reset to factory settings, and a phone that is not running the Dormouse app.
steps: Hold the dial for five seconds to start pairing.
Do nothing for three minutes.
Read the display.
expected: After three minutes the display shows E-104 and returns to its pairing screen, ready to try again.

title: E-305 when the boiler stops responding
preconditions: A thermostat wired to the boiler simulator on the test bench, calling for heat.
steps: Switch the boiler simulator off at the wall.
Wait five minutes and read the display.
Switch the simulator back on.
expected: The display shows E-305 within five minutes and the app shows a 'Boiler not responding' alert. Both clear once the boiler answers again.

title: Factory resetting the thermostat clears its Wi-Fi settings
preconditions: A paired thermostat connected to Wi-Fi.
steps: Open Settings on the thermostat and choose Factory reset.
Confirm by holding the dial for ten seconds.
Wait for the restart, then open the network screen.
expected: The thermostat restarts on the welcome screen with no saved Wi-Fi networks, and it no longer appears in the owner's app.

title: A weekday schedule changes the temperature at the set times
preconditions: A paired thermostat and a test clock that can be moved forward.
steps: Create a Monday to Friday schedule: 19 degrees at 06:30, 16 degrees at 08:30.
Save it and move the test clock to 06:29 on a Tuesday.
Watch the target temperature as the clock passes 06:30 and 08:30.
expected: The target temperature changes to 19 at 06:30 and to 16 at 08:30, on the thermostat and in the app.

title: Geofencing switches to away mode when everyone leaves home
preconditions: A household with two members, both with location sharing on, and a phone simulator that can fake its location.
steps: Move the first phone's location 2 km from home.
Check the thermostat is still in its normal mode.
Move the second phone's location 2 km from home and wait five minutes.
expected: Away mode only starts once both members have left. The thermostat drops to the away temperature and the app shows 'Everyone's out'.

title: Frost warning notification when the house drops below 5 degrees
preconditions: A thermostat on the test bench with its temperature reading overridden, and notifications allowed on the phone.
steps: Set the overridden reading to 4.5 degrees.
Wait one minute and look at the phone.
expected: A 'Frost warning' notification arrives, and frost protection turns the heating on whatever mode the thermostat is in.

title: Monthly energy report matches the heating hours
preconditions: A test account with a month of recorded heating history.
steps: Open Energy on the web dashboard and choose last month.
Add up the daily heating hours in the chart.
Compare the total with the heating log export.
expected: The report's total heating hours match the log export to within one hour.

title: Firmware update installs overnight and keeps the schedule
preconditions: A thermostat one firmware version behind, with a schedule set, and the test update server offering the new version.
steps: Move the test clock to 01:55.
Wait for the update window between 02:00 and 04:00.
After the restart, check the version number and the schedule.
expected: The new version installs between 02:00 and 04:00, the thermostat restarts by itself, and the schedule is unchanged.

title: Each room keeps its own temperature in a two-zone home
preconditions: Two thermostats paired to one home as 'Living room' and 'Bedroom'.
steps: Set the living room to 21 degrees and the bedroom to 17 degrees.
Wait for both to reach their targets.
Change the bedroom to 18 degrees.
expected: Each zone heats to its own target, and changing the bedroom does not change the living room.

title: An invited household member can change the temperature but not the schedule
preconditions: An owner account and a second account invited to the home as a member.
steps: Log in as the member.
Change the target temperature.
Open Schedules and try to edit a period.
expected: The temperature change works. The schedule opens read-only with the message 'Only the owner can change schedules'.

title: Boost button heats for one hour then returns to the schedule
preconditions: A thermostat following a schedule, with a test clock.
steps: Press the boost button once.
Move the test clock forward 60 minutes.
expected: Heating comes on straight away and the display counts down from 60. After an hour the thermostat goes back to the scheduled temperature.

title: Pair a new thermostat over Wi-Fi from the app
preconditions: A thermostat reset to factory settings and a phone on the same 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
steps: In the app, choose Add a thermostat.
Hold the thermostat's dial for five seconds until it shows a pairing code.
Enter the code in the app and choose the home Wi-Fi network.
expected: Within two minutes the thermostat appears in the app, shows the current room temperature and accepts a new target temperature.

title: Two-step verification code is required on a new browser
preconditions: An account with two-step verification switched on, and a browser that has never been used with it.
steps: Open the web dashboard in the new browser.
Log in with the email address and password.
Enter the six-digit code from the email.
expected: The dashboard asks for a code before showing anything, accepts the right code, and refuses a wrong one.

title: Displayed temperature matches a reference thermometer within half a degree
preconditions: A thermostat in the climate chamber next to a calibrated reference thermometer.
steps: Set the chamber to 15, 20 and 25 degrees in turn.
At each one, wait ten minutes and compare the two readings.
expected: At every temperature the thermostat's reading is within 0.5 degrees of the reference.
